svg.style: background: transparent; background-color: transparent; color-scheme: light dark;

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(218, 232, 252), rgb(29, 41, 59)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(29, 95, 168), rgb(113, 170, 232));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 148px; height: 1px; padding-top: 50px; margin-left: 1px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #15191f;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#15191f, #d5d8de); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
1 You press an arrow key
The page notes the key

2 The page sends the direction
Every 0.1 s while held
